task_summary: Migrated ProjectDetailsModal to shared Radix Dialog, Card, Avatar, Button, and Alert primitives; normalized ProjectSidebarInfo theme tokens and repeated Team prefixes; classified useActionDoneMatrix as a non-presentational hook. ProjectDetailsModal tests pass 7/7, MyProjectPage tests pass 8/8, scoped ESLint/Prettier pass, the 4,853-module production client build passes, and 20 Playwright captures cover approved/revision/pending modal states plus proposal/approved sidebar states across light/dark desktop/mobile. key_decisions: Replaced the project details modal custom portal and keyboard/body-scroll handlers with the shared Radix Dialog, preserving role and approval navigation behavior.
Used shared Card, Avatar, Button, Alert, and semantic tokens for modal content; preserved canonical document and institutional workflow behaviors.
Normalized repeated Team prefixes in both project presenters and hardened external links with noopener/noreferrer.
Classified useActionDoneMatrix.js as reviewed-no-ui because it contains no rendered markup or styling and its output is presented by shared ADM components.
lessons_learned: Windows Vitest cache renames can fail with EPERM when the process temp path is sandbox-managed; setting TEMP and TMP to a validated workspace-local scratch directory allowed the focused suite to pass.
CSS text-transform can change visible uppercase headings while DOM text remains case-sensitive; visual audit assertions should account for presentation transforms.
